# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_WITH_RSI_BOUNCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In an established uptrend (price above a rising VWAP), pullbacks to VWAP that coincide with RSI oversold provide high‑probability long entries. This edge exists because the VWAP acts as dynamic support in uptrends, and RSI <30 indicates exhaustion of the pullback, increasing the likelihood of a bounce with trend continuation.

## Mechanism

Entry: When price is above VWAP and VWAP is rising (current VWAP > prior VWAP), and price pulls back to touch or cross below VWAP while RSI(14) < 30, then go long at the first bar that closes back above VWAP with a bullish candle (close > open). Exit: Stop set below the most recent swing low (prior higher low); target at the prior session high or 1.5R, whichever is reached first. Regime filter: Only consider entries when EMA(9) > EMA(20) > EMA(50) and VIX < 20 to avoid choppy conditions.
